recipe.name: matched-ks3-all-output-init-gain01
recipe.hypothesis: Initialize only active KS3 feedforward output projections from a zero-mean normal distribution with standard deviation 0.1/sqrt(fan_in), rather than exact zeros. Nonzero output weights give input projections and spine coefficients a gradient on the first update; test whether earlier joint adaptation improves the timed training curve. An isolated seed-local CPU generator fills routed outputs then active dense outputs, preserving shared parameter/data RNG, all input projections, retained original MLPs and padding. Keep rank-one width1024, zero geometry coefficients, original output2x learning rates, geometry Adam0.125 with [.9,.99], ANVIL/masterweights/cache semantics, MoE8top1 and the frozen shared backend unchanged. This changes KS3 initialization only and does not assert a validation advantage.
